rules.rationale: Source ESOL evidence gave smiles_short a positive effect (+6.89, n=261); small solutes favored solvation.
Source prior for smiles_mid was negative (-6.61, n=226); transferred with reduced magnitude given low confidence.
Strongest source value prior (-11.46, confidence 0.47): large lipophilic solutes lose solvation favorability.
Source hbond_donor_bin maps to target hetero_atom_bin (transfer weight 0.51); donors drove favorable source effects.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers ESOL solubility structure (length priors plus donor-to-heteroatom role) to hydration ranking. May fail because FreeSolv hydration magnitude grows with polar surface, so size penalties could invert for polar mid-length solutes.

rules.rationale: Dense O/N centers form multiple water hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy.
Pure saturated hydrocarbons offer no hydrogen-bond sites; cavity formation dominates, giving weakest hydration.
Polyhalogenated solutes are weakly polar and bulky, historically poor hydration despite high polarizability.
Counter-hypothesis: reverses the low-confidence source smiles_mid penalty, since larger polar solutes accumulate hydration sites.

skills.hypothesis: Hydration affinity tracks polar hydrogen-bonding surface rather than chain length, so heteroatom content leads and the uncertain length prior is reversed. Fails if the score rewards hydrophobic bulk or halogen polarizability.

fixed_initial.lesson: Source ESOL roles had low confidence (0.16-0.41) and the length prior is the weakest link; mechanistic polarity terms are safer carriers for a hydration objective.
fixed_initial.revision_summary: Kept a literal source-prior transfer skill with damped length weights, and added a counter-hypothesis skill that leads with heteroatom polarity, penalizes apolar saturated and polyhalogenated solutes, and reverses the uncertain smiles_mid penalty. Selected the mechanistic polarity skill for frozen deployment.

rules.rationale: Dense O/N centers donate and accept multiple water hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable hydration term.
Intermediate polarity keeps coverage but is damped so it no longer dilutes the strongest polar stratum.
Apolar saturated solutes offer no hydrogen-bond sites; cavity formation cost dominates hydration free energy.
Heavily halogenated solutes are bulky, weakly hydrogen bonding, and typically poorly hydrated.

skills.hypothesis: Hydration affinity tracks polar hydrogen-bonding surface; sharpening the hetero_high anchor and damping hetero_mid should restore top-end reach. Fails if the score rewards hydrophobic bulk or halogen polarizability.

rules.rationale: Keeps the repeatedly useful polar hydrogen-bond anchor so the transferred role terms are tested, not confounded.
Highest-transfer source role (ring_bin, weight 0.758); single rings with polar groups hydrate well.
Source rotatable_bond role maps to branch tokens; branch points usually mark polar substituents in short SMILES.
Counter-hypothesis: the low-confidence ESOL smiles_short bonus is downweighted and mildly reversed, since tiny alkanes hydrate poorly.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers the two highest-weight source roles (ring, rotatable/branch) onto a damped polarity anchor while nearly nulling the uncertain length prior. Fails if ring and branch effects invert for hydration.

true_feedback.lesson: Across two development generations the mechanistic polarity skill led by roughly 15-23 AUC over length-prior skills in both literal and reversed forms, so length transfer is unreliable; broad hetero_mid weighting may have blunted top-end reach, warranting a sharper polar anchor.
true_feedback.revision_summary: Retained the winning polarity skill but damped hetero_mid, strengthened the hetero_high anchor and apolar penalties, and slightly reduced semantic mass to preserve exploration. Replaced the failed length-reversal skill with a role-transfer counter-hypothesis that carries the highest-weight source roles (ring, branch) on a damped polarity anchor while nearly nulling the uncertain length prior. Deployed the polarity skill.

rules.rationale: Dense O/N centers donate and accept several water hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy.
Saturated hydrocarbons offer no polar contacts; cavity-formation cost dominates, giving the weakest hydration in FreeSolv-type data.
Heavily halogenated solutes are bulky and poor hydrogen bonders despite polarizability, so hydration stays unfavorable.
Intermediate heteroatom counts retain hydrogen-bond capacity; graded polarity term stabilizes the surrogate across 91 candidates.

skills.hypothesis: Hydration affinity tracks polar hydrogen-bonding surface, so graded heteroatom content leads while apolar and polyhalogenated solutes are penalized. Fails if the score instead rewards hydrophobic bulk or halogen polarizability.

rules.rationale: Counter-hypothesis: reverses the low-confidence source smiles_mid penalty, since mid-size solutes accumulate multiple polar hydration sites.
Reverses the source smiles_short bonus: the short bin is dominated by small alkanes and halomethanes that hydrate weakly.
Moderate double-bond counts flag carbonyl, amide and ester groups, which are strong water hydrogen-bond acceptors.
Uses the rotatable-to-branch role but damped: heavily branched solutes raise cavity cost, though the source sign is unverified.

skills.hypothesis: Counter-hypothesis flipping the ESOL size priors: hydration magnitude grows with polar functionality rather than shrinking with size. Fails if FreeSolv scores still favor the smallest solutes as the source data suggested.

no_feedback.lesson: Source roles are low confidence (0.16-0.41) and only length carries signed value priors, so mechanistic hydrogen-bonding polarity terms remain the safer deployment while size priors stay in the counter-hypothesis.
no_feedback.revision_summary: Rewrote all conditions as field-to-value objects, kept the mechanistic polar-surface skill with slightly lower semantic mass, and rebuilt the second skill as a sharper counter-hypothesis that reverses both ESOL length priors, adds a carbonyl-acceptor term, and damps the rotatable-to-branch role. Deployed the polar hydrogen-bond surface skill.

rules.rationale: Source ESOL prior for smiles_short was +6.89 (n=261); compact solutes pay little cavity-formation cost.
Source smiles_mid effect -6.61 (n=226), damped because the length role confidence is only 0.22.
Strongest source value prior (-11.46, confidence 0.47): bulky lipophilic solutes lose solvation favorability.
Donor-to-heteroatom role (transfer weight 0.51); multiple O/N centers add favorable water hydrogen bonds.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers the ESOL size ordering with a moderate heteroatom tilt, restoring the configuration that led on generation-0 seeds while the target anchor takes over late. Fails if hydration favors large polar solutes.

rules.rationale: Ring role carries the highest source transfer weight (0.76); cyclic solutes expose polarizable surface with modest cavity cost.
Counter-hypothesis: reverses the low-confidence (0.27) source smiles_mid penalty, since mid-size solutes accumulate hydration sites.
Solutes with neither heteroatoms nor halogens offer no polar contacts; cavity formation dominates hydration.
Polyhalogenated solutes hydrogen bond weakly and are bulky, a classic hydrophobic hydration penalty.

skills.hypothesis: Hydration ranking is set by ring and polar-contact chemistry rather than raw length, so the weak mid-length penalty is reversed. Fails if short saturated solutes actually dominate the score.

shuffled_feedback.lesson: In both development generations the source-derived length-prior skill outranked its mechanistic rival on matched seeds, but absolute AUC differed strongly across seed blocks, so cross-generation drops should not be read as parameter effects; revert toward the best matched-seed configuration instead of over-damping.
shuffled_feedback.revision_summary: Restored the generation-0 heteroatom weight (0.35), prior_scale (0.30) and semantic mass (0.42/0.14) for the winning length-prior transfer, with slightly more early exploration. Replaced the compact-apolar counter with a ring-role counter-hypothesis that exploits the highest-weight unused source role, reverses the weak mid-length penalty, and keeps mechanistic hydrocarbon and polyhalogen penalties under light semantic mass. Deployed the restored length-prior transfer.
